unit.title: Watching dramas
canDo: Talk about a show you're watching
Say what you understood, by ear or by reading
Follow a short scene from its subtitles

example.en: I watch TV in the evening.

vocabulary.usageNote: Most Chinese shows and films have Chinese subtitles burned in.

example.zh: 中文字幕还是英语字幕？

example.py: Wǒ kàn dào dì wǔ jí le.
Nǐ kàn dào dì jǐ jí le?

grammar.pattern: 看懂 / 听懂 · 没看懂 / 没听懂
grammar.purpose: Say whether you understood, and how
grammar.explanation: 懂 after a verb shows the result: 看懂 (understood by reading or watching), 听懂 (understood by ear). Done: 看懂了. Not: 没看懂, 没听懂. With fast speech you might 没听懂 but 看懂了 the subtitles.

examples.zh: 他们说话太快，我没听懂。
examples.py: Tāmen shuōhuà tài kuài, wǒ méi tīngdǒng.
examples.en: They talk too fast; I didn't catch it.

commonMistakes.why: For a result that didn't happen, use 没.

grammar.pattern: A 还是 B？ · 第 + number
grammar.purpose: Ask "A or B?"; say which episode
grammar.explanation: 还是 offers a choice in a question: 中文字幕还是英语字幕？ (No 吗 needed.) 第 + number makes an ordinal: 第一集 (episode one), 第几集？ (which episode?).

examples.zh: 中文字幕还是英语字幕？

examples.py: Nǐ kàn dào dì jǐ jí le?

dialogue.title: Binge-watching

lines.speaker: anna
lines.zh: 一个中国电视剧，很好看！
lines.py: Yí ge Zhōngguó diànshìjù, hěn hǎokàn!
lines.en: A Chinese drama. It's so good!

lines.speaker: anna
lines.zh: 有字幕，我看懂了一点儿。
lines.py: Yǒu zìmù, wǒ kàndǒng le yìdiǎnr.
lines.en: There are subtitles. I follow a bit.

lines.speaker: chenyu
lines.zh: 中文字幕还是英语字幕？

lines.speaker: anna
lines.zh: 中文的！他们说话太快，可是字幕我看懂了。
lines.py: Zhōngwén de! Tāmen shuōhuà tài kuài, kěshì zìmù wǒ kàndǒng le.

lines.zh: 太好了！你看到第几集了？

lines.en: Brilliant! Which episode are you on?

questions.q: How does she manage to follow the story?
choices: She reads the subtitles when the speech is too fast
She understands every word by ear
questions.answer: She reads the subtitles when the speech is too fast

reading.title: Subtitles: episode one
reading.blurb: Subtitles from a scene in an original mini-drama.
reading.purpose: These are the subtitles from a scene. Read them as if they were flashing by: what did Daming forget, and how does he fix it?

lines.speaker: linan
lines.py: Wǒ zài děng nǐ. Nǐ wàng le ma?
lines.en: Waiting for you. Did you forget?

lines.speaker: daming

lines.py: Bié shēngqì! Wǒmen qù chīfàn ba, wǒ qǐng nǐ!
lines.en: Don't be mad! Let's go to dinner, my treat!

pragmatics.situation: Offering to pay for a friend

tooFormal.py: Zhè dùn fàn yóu wǒ lái fùkuǎn.

pragmatics.note: 我请你 means "I'm paying". Friends often argue over the bill; offering is polite.

natural.zh: 这个电视剧很好看，你看吧！
natural.py: Zhège diànshìjù hěn hǎokàn, nǐ kàn ba!

pragmatics.note: 吧 makes it a friendly push, not an order.

line.py: Nǐ kàn dào dì jǐ jí le?

lines.zh: 我每天晚上看中国【电视剧】。他们说话很快，可是有中文【字幕】，我能看【懂】。
lines.py: Wǒ měi tiān wǎnshang kàn Zhōngguó diànshìjù. Tāmen shuōhuà hěn kuài, kěshì yǒu Zhōngwén zìmù, wǒ néng kàndǒng.
lines.en: I watch a Chinese drama every evening. They talk fast, but there are Chinese subtitles, so I can follow it.
